name: From a named piece of work to its design
outcome: The product owner runs three plays on a business intent and gets a slice to test, a plan with one epic and one story for each feature, and an eval that no build is given; a check flags each build session that read the evals folder.

surface.name: the Claude Code command line
surface.user_action: runs /shape-slice, then /shape-plan, then /shape-eval on a business intent, then runs the check that shows no build play's inputs name the evals folder and that flags a build session that read it

why_this_order: The slice must exist before its plan, and the plan's epic and stories before the eval that reads them. The check of fn-898 comes last, because it can only be tested when the evals folder holds an eval that a build must not be given.

left_out.what: Running the eval after the build (also on Griffin)
left_out.why: The approved design puts it out of scope (798/specs/design.md line 31), and fn-798 lists it as out of scope (fn-798/feature.md line 29).

left_out.what: Blocking a read of the evals folder by a hook (#893)
left_out.why: Story #898 only flags the read and does not block it; blocking is the guardrails work (#893), out of scope in the design (line 31-32).
The product owner dropped encryption and #828 on 2026-10-26 (798/specs/design.md lines 7-10): everything stays in plain text.

left_out.what: Changing the proof line of business intent 788 that says no builder can read the eval
left_out.why: Question Q-proof-1 is not answered yet; its assumption leaves the intent page as it is in this run and names the gap in the brief.

left_out.what: The design, build, test or validation of an epic (#819)
left_out.why: The intent's Must not excludes it (bi-788.md line 18); so the slice has no build play of its own, and the check of fn-898 treats every play except /shape-slice, /shape-eval and the eval as a build play (assumption of Q-builders-1).

decisions.question: Which features does the slice hold?
decisions.answer: fn-795, fn-818 and fn-798, kept as they are, and the new feature fn-898 (the build is given the business intent, never the eval; a check flags each build session that read the evals folder) under cap-shape-eval.

decisions.question: In which order are the features built?
decisions.answer: fn-795, then fn-818, then fn-798, then fn-898.
